ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the Grafana admin account. Auto-generated during install.

ANONYMOUS_MODE.description: Let people view dashboards without logging in. Useful for displaying dashboards on a kitchen iPad or shared screen.

ALLOW_SIGN_UP.description: Let new users register their own accounts from the login page. Keep off for a private instance.

DEFAULT_THEME.description: The default UI theme for new users. System follows your operating system's appearance setting.

ANALYTICS_REPORTING.description: Share anonymous usage statistics with Grafana Labs to help improve the product.

CHECK_FOR_UPDATES.description: Let Grafana check for new versions of itself and its plugins. Disable for fully offline operation.

GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER.description: Username for the Grafana admin account.
